author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪವಿರಬಹುದು ವಿಧಿಕೊಟ್ಟ ಜನುಮದಲಿ
ನಿಕ್ಷೇಪಮನ ಸಾಂದ್ರ ಗುಣರತ್ನ ಖನಿಜ
ಸಂಕ್ಷೇಪದಲಿ ಹೊಮ್ಮೆ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯ ರೂಪದಲಿ
ವಿಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತ ಮನವ ತೊರೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There may be distortions in the birth fate has given;
the mind is a treasury, dense with gem-like virtues;
when they shine out in brief, as words and deeds,
leave the scattered mind behind, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Whatever flaws our birth has given us, the mind holds a treasure of virtues. Let them show in what we say and do, and let go of a restless, scattered mind.
